# navigation-index

> Knowledge hub for navigation / PNT / GNSS-denied autonomy with a defense lens: 787 open-source repos, 696 documents, talks, courses and datasets, 47 usage samples and 32 guides, linked in one graph over 46 concepts.

Read AGENTS.md for how to query and extend. For a problem statement, run `python3 tools/query.py decode "<statement>"` (MCP tool `decode`) or read docs/problem-statement-decoder.md to pick its rows, then search with each row's keywords: `python3 tools/query.py search "<keywords>"` or the MCP server tools/mcp_server.py (its `read` tool returns any guide or sample README). Guides (kind `guide`) are searchable like any other node.

## Entry points

- [docs/problem-statement-decoder.md](docs/problem-statement-decoder.md): got a problem statement? start here (statement => approach, stack, data, starting sample, risk, pitch)
- [docs/day0-runbook.md](docs/day0-runbook.md): the first three hours after the statement drops
- [samples/README.md](samples/README.md): every sample with status, deps, first command, key result
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): map of docs/ and read order
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how agents use and extend the hub
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): concept tree and high hackathon-fit repos
- [docs/integration-cards/](docs/integration-cards/): per-repo install, wiring, gotchas, license
- [docs/dataset-cards/README.md](docs/dataset-cards/README.md): checked dataset sizes and licenses
- [templates/README.md](templates/README.md): team repo skeleton, demo dashboard, offline kit
- [site/index.html](site/index.html): static web UI (serve the repo root over HTTP, open /site/)
- [docs/SCHEMA.md](docs/SCHEMA.md): data model
- [index/records.jsonl](index/records.jsonl): every node as one JSON line
- [graph/graph.json](graph/graph.json): nodes and edges

## Guides

- [Docs map](docs/README.md): What each page under docs/ is for and the order to read them in.
- [Data schema](docs/SCHEMA.md): The source of truth is JSON under data/.
- [Autopilot GNSS fault handling: PX4 EKF2 and ArduPilot EKF3 under spoofing](docs/autopilot-gnss-fault-handling.md): What each autopilot's EKF does when GNSS goes wrong, read from the source at pinned tags and checked in SITL by samples/autopilot-spoof-response (45 flights, 2026-11-06).
- [Day-0 runbook: the first 3 hours](docs/day0-runbook.md): What a 4-5 person team does from the moment the problem statement drops until H+3, when a walking skeleton should run end to end.
- [Evidence matrix](docs/evidence-matrix.md): Recording/replay plumbing: recording-replay ran on 2026-11-07 with 101 synthetic poses over 10 s.
- [Export control and ethics](docs/export-control-and-ethics.md): Not legal advice.
- [Hackathon playbook: navigation and PNT under GNSS denial](docs/hackathon-playbook.md): For a team going into a navigation-themed hackathon that may have a military or defense track.
- [Integrity monitoring for navigation and alt-PNT](docs/integrity-monitoring.md): After this page you can explain what a protection level is and why it is different from an accuracy number, run a solution-separation monitor over several alt-PNT sources, and show judges a Stanford diagram that proves your navigator does ...
- [Landscape: what judges already know](docs/landscape/README.md): Commercial products, funded programmes and 2025-2026 trends in GNSS-denied navigation, so a hackathon team can place its idea against what is already sold or funded.
- ["Polyot vslepuyu" (Blind flight) 2026: problem teardown and seven public solutions](docs/landscape/blind-flight-teardown.md): The closest real precedent we have for a navigation hackathon brief: a 48-hour case (26-28 June 2026, Krasnodar, track "Robotics and sensing") where teams had to find position, ground speed and heading of an aircraft from a radar altimeter ...
- [GNSS-denied navigation: products and companies](docs/landscape/gnss-denied-nav-products.md): What judges from industry already know.
- [Programs, challenges and hackathons (2023-2026)](docs/landscape/programs-and-challenges.md): What funders publish as navigation problem statements.
- [Navigation trends 2025-2026](docs/landscape/trends-2025-2026.md): Each item: what changed, the source, and what it means for a navigation hackathon project.
- [Ukrainian- and Russian-language sources: what they add](docs/landscape/ua-ru-sources-overview.md): Lane ua-ru-sources: 38 resources and 12 repos, all tagged lang:uk or lang:ru.
- [Learning paths](docs/learning-paths.md): Three study tracks built from the courses, talks, books and docs in this index.
- [Model weights licenses: code vs weights vs training data](docs/model-weights-licenses.md): Learned models in navigation pipelines carry three separate sets of terms:
- [Choose a stack you can run](docs/practical-readiness.md): Start with the problem decoder, then narrow the candidates by the resources in the room.
- [1. PNT fundamentals](docs/primer/01-pnt-fundamentals.md): After this chapter you can describe any navigation system as "a state, an uncertainty, a set of measurements and a way to check they agree", and you will know the vocabulary judges use when they ask whether your solution is "assured".
- [2. GNSS and its threats](docs/primer/02-gnss-and-threats.md): After this chapter you can explain how a receiver turns satellite signals into a position, read raw receiver output, pick between SPP, RTK and PPP, and build a jamming or spoofing detector that runs on recorded data.
- [3. Inertial navigation and sensor fusion](docs/primer/03-inertial-and-fusion.md): After this chapter you can explain why an IMU drifts, write the predict/update loop of a Kalman filter, choose between a filter and a factor graph, and configure an off-the-shelf estimator to survive a GNSS outage.
- [4. Vision, LiDAR and radar odometry](docs/primer/04-vision-lidar-radar-odometry.md): After this chapter you can explain how a camera, LiDAR or radar measures motion, what SLAM adds on top of odometry, and which open stack to run on which sensor.
- [5. Absolute alternative PNT](docs/primer/05-absolute-alt-pnt.md): After this chapter you can explain the five main ways to get an absolute position without GNSS - image-to-map matching, terrain matching, magnetic anomaly matching, celestial fixes and signals of opportunity - pick the one that fits your ...
- [6. Autopilots and C2](docs/primer/06-autopilots-and-c2.md): After this chapter you can run PX4 or ArduPilot in simulation, inject your own position source over MAVLink, configure the estimator to switch away from GNSS, and push your vehicle's position and detections onto a TAK common operating ...
- [7. Maps, geodesy and planning](docs/primer/07-maps-geodesy-planning.md): After this chapter you can convert between the coordinate systems your tools disagree on, fetch free imagery and elevation data for a region, display it, and plan a path or a multi-vehicle mission over it.
- [8. Maritime, underwater, ground and dismounted](docs/primer/08-maritime-underwater-ground.md): After this chapter you know how navigation changes off the drone: what ships broadcast and how spoofing shows up in it, how vehicles navigate underwater where no radio reaches, how ground robots and pedestrians dead-reckon, and which open ...
- [9. Evaluation and datasets](docs/primer/09-evaluation-and-datasets.md): After this chapter you can pick a dataset or simulator that matches your scenario, compute the trajectory metrics judges and reviewers expect, and design a GNSS-outage or interference test that shows what your system does when it matters.
- [Navigation primer](docs/primer/README.md): A field guide to navigation and PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) for software engineers joining a defense-flavoured hackathon.
- [Problem-statement decoder](docs/problem-statement-decoder.md): Plausible problem statements for a navigation / PNT / GNSS-denied hackathon, each mapped to a recommended approach, a stack (integration cards first, catalog pages otherwise), datasets, a sample or template to start from, the main risk and ...
- [Reference stacks: if you only have X, use Y](docs/reference-stacks.md): Opinionated picks for a 24-48h build.
- [Three selective offline starter bundles](docs/starter-bundles.md): Pick a bundle before downloading the broad offline kit.
- [Timing resilience: the T in PNT](docs/timing-resilience.md): After this page you can explain why a GNSS-denied system loses time before it loses position, estimate how long a given oscillator holds time from its datasheet, name the attacks on GNSS and network time, and pick a 24-48 h build that ...
- [Upstream findings](docs/upstream-findings.md): Defects and gaps that the hub's samples found in other people's code and data, with what a maintainer needs to act on them.

## Samples

Status: ran = main path executed, partial = part ran, sketch = nothing ran.

- [altpnt-integrity](samples/altpnt-integrity/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Stdlib EKF (INS + VIO + visual geoloc + jammed then spoofed GNSS) with solution-separation FDE, protection level, MI/HMI, Stanford diagram; v2 recalibrates every error model on measured sibling-sample data
- [ardupilot-ekf3-source-switch](samples/ardupilot-ekf3-source-switch/README.md) (ran, docker): EKF3 source-set switch to ExternalNav (SITL vicon) around a GPS cut, plus a no-switch contrast run
- [autopilot-resilient-configs](samples/autopilot-resilient-configs/README.md) (ran, docker): Which PX4 EKF2 / ArduPilot EKF3 configurations keep flying under a coherent GNSS drag, measured: Lua source switch, EV velocity + GPS mode 1, dual GPS, blending, gates, glitch clipping
- [autopilot-spoof-response](samples/autopilot-spoof-response/README.md) (ran, docker): Why PX4 EKF2 and ArduPilot EKF3 end up on a spoofed position (gate rejection, then reset-to-GNSS after 7 s / 10 s), measured over drag rate, step size and gate settings in SITL
- [blind-flight-bench](samples/blind-flight-bench/README.md) (ran, venv): Benchmark for the 2026 Blind flight brief: 20 km radar-altimeter flights over four real GLO-30 windows, 10 navigators incl. clean-room team re-implementations
- [celestial-star-tracker](samples/celestial-star-tracker/README.md) (ran, venv): cedar-solve lost-in-space on real star images vs a known WCS, then lat/lon from star elevations above an IMU vertical; error budget for level, vibration, accel bias, clock, refraction
- [cuas-classifiers](samples/cuas-classifiers/README.md) (ran, venv): UAV vs bird from real radar tracks (NRC Echodyne) and DroneRF detection / identification
- [dismounted-foot-ins](samples/dismounted-foot-ins/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Stdlib 15-state ZUPT EKF on 36 real pyshoe trials, cross-checked with pyshoe; corridor heading, floor, simulated UWB; CoT/navdash
- [e2e-visual-nav-vpair](samples/e2e-visual-nav-vpair/README.md) (ran, venv): Full chain on one real flight: nadir VO => DINOv2 top-5 => LightGlue fixes => voting => altpnt v2 EKF + gate / solution separation, scored per km
- [geoloc-license-clean](samples/geoloc-license-clean/README.md) (ran, venv): Same pipeline with permissive parts only (ALIKED / DISK / SIFT + LightGlue, NAIP maps), synthetic and real eBee frames
- [gnss-ins-ekf-outage](samples/gnss-ins-ekf-outage/README.md) (ran, stdlib): 2D loosely coupled GNSS/INS EKF: INS-only drift, 60 s outage, spoof walk-off vs gate and latch
- [gnss-interference-monitor](samples/gnss-interference-monitor/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Per-receiver scorer for jamming, spoofing (incl. staircase power and spoofer ephemerides), clock drift and lost fix from u-blox telemetry, evaluated on real Jammertest 2024 logs; ADS-B NACp area map
- [gnss-rinex-processing](samples/gnss-rinex-processing/README.md) (ran, docker): RTKLIB demo5 SPP/RTK and gnss_lib_py WLS on public NOAA CORS RINEX, scored against the NGS coordinate
- [gnss-signal-chain](samples/gnss-signal-chain/README.md) (ran, docker): File-only GPS L1 IQ chain: gps-sdr-sim => spoof/jam mixer => GNSS-SDR => scorer, four scenarios
- [golden-demo](samples/golden-demo/README.md) (ran, docker): ArduCopter SITL survey, GPS dragged (position or coherent); companion detects with SS + velocity test against real geoloc, switches EKF3 to ExternalNav; dashboard replay; 52-flight Monte Carlo
- [golden-demo-fixedwing](samples/golden-demo-fixedwing/README.md) (ran, docker): golden-demo monitor on an ArduPlane SITL 27.6 km route: coherent GPS drag, EKF3 switch to ExternalNav fed by measured day (VPAIR) / night (thermal) geoloc models vs airspeed dead reckoning only; cross-track vs distance and end-of-route ...
- [golden-demo-px4](samples/golden-demo-px4/README.md) (ran, docker): golden-demo v2 ported to PX4 v1.17 SIH: coherent GPS drag via HIL_GPS, the same companion monitor (SS + PL, GNSS-vs-VIO velocity test), EKF2 switched from GNSS to external vision; ArduPilot side by side
- [interference-geolocation-to-tak](samples/interference-geolocation-to-tak/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Jammer triangulation from KrakenSDR-style DF bearings (stdlib RANSAC + Gauss-Newton, Stone Soup PF/UKF) => CoT point + 95 % ellipse
- [jammer-sensor-network](samples/jammer-sensor-network/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Many cheap receivers report C/N0 drop and AGC; aggregator localizes the jammer (centroid, RSS least squares, grid Bayes, optional DF) => CoT + navdash
- [llm-agent-usage](samples/llm-agent-usage/README.md) (ran, stdlib): The hub's stdlib MCP server (search / show / concept / neighbors) piped a demo session; client registration snippets
- [llm-mission-agent](samples/llm-mission-agent/README.md) (partial, docker): Safety-gated MAVLink MCP server (geofence, altitude band, mode allowlist, dry run) flying ArduCopter SITL; Claude tool-use loop included but not run
- [magnav-quickstart](samples/magnav-quickstart/README.md) (ran, docker): MagNav.jl Tolles-Lawson + EKF on real SGL 2020 flight line 1006.08
- [maritime-ais-spoofing](samples/maritime-ais-spoofing/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Stdlib detectors for spoofing signatures in real Danish AIS; recall and TTD on injected episodes; GeoJSON + CoT
- [mavlink-to-tak-cot](samples/mavlink-to-tak-cot/README.md) (ran, stdlib): MAVLink GLOBAL_POSITION_INT => CoT; stdlib builder plus pymavlink/PyTAK bridge
- [multi-source-fde](samples/multi-source-fde/README.md) (ran, venv): ARAIM-style subset exclusion (exclude only if exactly one subset is self-consistent, else unavailable) vs detection-only and max-separation exclusion, on a real flight with 3-4 absolute sources and single and double faults
- [osint-jamming-map](samples/osint-jamming-map/README.md) (ran, venv): Free OSINT layers for one day over the SE Baltic: ADS-B NACp hexes vs Sentinel-1 C-band RFI
- [osnma-authentication](samples/osnma-authentication/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Galileo OSNMA on a real recorded I/NAV stream with unmodified OSNMAlib under 10 manipulations; adapter turns auth status into scorer alerts
- [px4-sitl-gps-denial](samples/px4-sitl-gps-denial/README.md) (ran, docker): 15 s GPS denial on PX4 v1.17.0 SIH, EKF2 drift vs ground truth
- [real-attack-replay](samples/real-attack-replay/README.md) (ran, stdlib): The interference monitor on real Jammertest 2024 jamming and spoofing: per-test detection, time to detect, false alarms, and RTKLIB SPP error
- [recording-replay](samples/recording-replay/README.md) (ran, stdlib): One explicit pose/time/frame contract replayed from JSONL and optional schema-bearing MCAP
- [relative-nav-benchmark](samples/relative-nav-benchmark/README.md) (ran, venv): KISS-ICP, OpenVINS, mono and nadir VO on KITTI 04, UZH-FPV and VPAIR, scored with evo; fitted error models fed to altpnt-integrity
- [remote-id-to-tak](samples/remote-id-to-tak/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Stdlib Open Drone ID decoder validated against opendroneid-core-c, track table with plausibility flags, CoT via PyTAK
- [sitl-docker](samples/sitl-docker/README.md) (ran, docker): Headless ArduCopter 4.6.3 SITL and PX4 v1.17.0 SIH images, compose file, client image
- [stone-soup-tracking](samples/stone-soup-tracking/README.md) (ran, venv): Stone Soup EKF + JPDA on two simulated UAVs in radar clutter, OSPA vs truth
- [swarm-coop-localization](samples/swarm-coop-localization/README.md) (ran, stdlib): 6 vehicles, 2 with GNSS, UWB ranging: centralized EKF vs covariance intersection, robust ranging, spoofed-anchor detection
- [swarm-coop-real-uwb](samples/swarm-coop-real-uwb/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Swarm-coop filters on real MILUV inter-drone UWB: real vs simulated range error, DR vs centralized vs CI, injected anchor fault and detection time
- [terrain-heightmap-pf](samples/terrain-heightmap-pf/README.md) (ran, venv): Heightmap-gradient particle filter and radar-altimeter TERCOM on real GLO-30 terrain; v2 information gate, compass-bias state, confidence, 1 m LiDAR
- [terrain-relative-nav-pf](samples/terrain-relative-nav-pf/README.md) (partial, stdlib): Stdlib SIR particle filter: biased INS + radar altimeter vs a synthetic DEM, flat-terrain control
- [thermal-geolocalization](samples/thermal-geolocalization/README.md) (ran, venv): Night / thermal frame => RGB satellite fix by condition, modality-bridging preprocessing, a gate that accepted no wrong fix, CPU vs MPS timing
- [timing-holdover](samples/timing-holdover/README.md) (ran, stdlib): GNSS-disciplined oscillator sim (TCXO / CSAC / OCXO / Rb): holdover error after outage, slow time-walk spoof vs internal and cross-source monitors
- [timing-network-holdover](samples/timing-network-holdover/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Six GNSS-disciplined sites over PTP-like links: holdover from peers vs alone under regional jamming, cross-node consistency check isolating a time push, ADEV-weighted ensemble vs best clock, cost of path asymmetry
- [two-source-integrity-vpair](samples/two-source-integrity-vpair/README.md) (ran, venv): Second absolute source (TRN from real NRW LiDAR at real VPAIR poses) turns solution-separation integrity from 1.6 % to 84 % available at AL 50 m; fault injection with detection and attribution limits
- [ugv-gnss-outage-real](samples/ugv-gnss-outage-real/README.md) (ran, stdlib): Real Segway log (NCLT): GNSS outages bridged by wheel odometry vs MEMS INS, chi-square gate on real multipath, injected drag detection with gate vs odometry displacement test
- [usv-gnss-denied-nav](samples/usv-gnss-denied-nav/README.md) (ran, stdlib): USV own-ship nav in the Oresund: compass + speed-log DR, simulated radar matched to the real OSM chart, monitor excludes spoofed GNSS
- [vio-to-mavlink-bridge](samples/vio-to-mavlink-bridge/README.md) (partial, stdlib): ENU/FLU pose => NED/FRD ODOMETRY or VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE for EKF3 / EKF2
- [visual-geolocalization-lightglue](samples/visual-geolocalization-lightglue/README.md) (ran, venv): Nadir frame => orthophoto match (LightGlue, MAGSAC homography, GeoTIFF transform) => lat/lon; stdlib geometry module
- [vpr-large-area](samples/vpr-large-area/README.md) (ran, venv): Coarse first stage for a lost UAV: DINOv2 GeM / CLS / VLAD retrieval over a 49 km2 NAIP tile DB with no position prior and unknown heading, chained to ALIKED + LightGlue fine matching with an inlier gate

## Concepts

- [GNSS positioning](catalog/concepts/gnss.md): 145 items - GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC: signals, receivers, positioning.
- [RTK / PPP precise positioning](catalog/concepts/gnss-rtk-ppp.md): 39 items - Carrier-phase differential and precise point positioning, corrections (RTCM, SSR, NTRIP).
- [Software-defined GNSS receivers](catalog/concepts/gnss-sdr.md): 35 items - Acquisition, tracking, navigation-message decoding in software on SDR front-ends.
- [Jamming and spoofing](catalog/concepts/gnss-interference.md): 185 items - GNSS interference, spoofing simulation, detection, mitigation, monitoring, anti-jam antennas (CRPA).
- [Assured / resilient PNT](catalog/concepts/assured-pnt.md): 266 items - Architectures that keep position, navigation and timing trustworthy under denial and deception.
- [Timing and time transfer](catalog/concepts/timing.md): 144 items - Clocks, holdover, PTP/NTP, GNSS-disciplined oscillators, chip-scale atomic clocks.
- [Inertial navigation (INS/IMU)](catalog/concepts/ins.md): 135 items - Strapdown mechanization, IMU error models, calibration, dead reckoning.
- [Sensor fusion and state estimation](catalog/concepts/sensor-fusion.md): 225 items - Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/ESKF/IEKF), factor graphs, smoothing, multi-sensor integration.
- [GNSS/INS integration](catalog/concepts/gnss-ins.md): 71 items - Loosely, tightly and deeply coupled GNSS/INS.
- [Sensor calibration](catalog/concepts/calibration.md): 38 items - Camera-IMU, LiDAR-IMU extrinsics, intrinsics, time offset, Allan variance.
- [Visual(-inertial) odometry](catalog/concepts/vio.md): 148 items - VO/VIO from monocular, stereo, event cameras with IMU.
- [Visual SLAM](catalog/concepts/visual-slam.md): 91 items - Mapping and localization with loop closure from cameras.
- [LiDAR odometry and SLAM](catalog/concepts/lidar-slam.md): 96 items - LiDAR(-inertial) odometry, scan matching, LiDAR mapping.
- [Radar navigation and odometry](catalog/concepts/radar-nav.md): 34 items - Radar odometry, radar SLAM, radar altimeters, Doppler velocity.
- [Place recognition and loop closure](catalog/concepts/place-recognition.md): 75 items - Global descriptors, image retrieval, LiDAR place recognition.
- [Feature detection and matching](catalog/concepts/feature-matching.md): 66 items - Keypoints/descriptors and learned matchers (SIFT, SuperPoint, LightGlue, LoFTR).
- [Visual geo-localization (image-to-map)](catalog/concepts/visual-geolocalization.md): 144 items - Matching UAV/ground imagery to satellite orthophotos or maps for absolute position without GNSS.
- [Terrain-relative navigation](catalog/concepts/terrain-nav.md): 61 items - TERCOM/TRN/DSMAC-style matching of altimetry or imagery against DEM/terrain databases.
- [Magnetic anomaly navigation](catalog/concepts/magnetic-nav.md): 45 items - MagNav: matching magnetometer readings to crustal anomaly maps; aircraft compensation.
- [Celestial and star-tracker navigation](catalog/concepts/celestial-nav.md): 24 items - Star trackers, sun/sky polarization, celestial fixes.
- [Signals of opportunity](catalog/concepts/signals-of-opportunity.md): 65 items - Positioning from LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, DVB, LEO satellites (Starlink, Iridium), eLoran, other non-navigation RF.
- [RF localization and direction finding](catalog/concepts/rf-localization.md): 56 items - UWB, TDOA/AOA, direction finding, emitter geolocation, beacons.
- [Indoor and pedestrian navigation](catalog/concepts/indoor-pedestrian.md): 24 items - PDR, foot-mounted INS, dismounted soldier navigation, indoor positioning.
- [Autopilots and flight control](catalog/concepts/autopilot.md): 85 items - Flight stacks, control loops, estimation inside autopilots, firmware.
- [MAVLink, ground control and C2 links](catalog/concepts/mavlink-gcs.md): 57 items - MAVLink protocol, SDKs, ground control stations, telemetry radios.
- [Path and motion planning](catalog/concepts/path-planning.md): 61 items - Global/local planners, sampling and search based planning, trajectory optimization.
- [Mission planning and routing](catalog/concepts/mission-planning.md): 34 items - Route networks, waypoint missions, coverage, terrain-aware and threat-aware routing.
- [Obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance](catalog/concepts/obstacle-avoidance.md): 36 items - Reactive avoidance, sense-and-avoid, DAA.
- [Swarms and multi-agent navigation](catalog/concepts/multi-agent.md): 84 items - Cooperative localization, swarm control, multi-robot SLAM, formation flight.
- [GIS, maps and geospatial data](catalog/concepts/gis-mapping.md): 66 items - Map engines, tiles, DEMs, orthophotos, coordinate systems, geodesy.
- [Geodesy and coordinate frames](catalog/concepts/geodesy.md): 27 items - Datums, projections, ECEF/ENU/NED, MGRS, geoid models.
- [Situational awareness and C2 interop](catalog/concepts/situational-awareness.md): 104 items - TAK/CoT, MIL-STD-2525/APP-6 symbology, blue force tracking, common operating picture.
- [Maritime navigation](catalog/concepts/maritime-nav.md): 50 items - Surface vessel navigation, AIS, ECDIS/charts, USVs.
- [Underwater navigation](catalog/concepts/underwater-nav.md): 28 items - DVL, USBL/LBL acoustics, AUV navigation, underwater SLAM.
- [Ground vehicle autonomy](catalog/concepts/ground-vehicle-nav.md): 67 items - UGV/off-road autonomy stacks, localization and navigation for ground robots.
- [Space and orbital navigation](catalog/concepts/space-nav.md): 38 items - Orbit determination, LEO-PNT, spacecraft navigation.
- [Simulation and HIL/SITL](catalog/concepts/simulation.md): 121 items - Physics and sensor simulators, software/hardware-in-the-loop, GNSS signal simulators.
- [Datasets and benchmarks](catalog/concepts/datasets-benchmarks.md): 221 items - Public datasets, evaluation tools, leaderboards for navigation and localization.
- [ROS / ROS 2 robotics middleware](catalog/concepts/ros.md): 104 items - ROS ecosystem packages for navigation and localization.
- [Onboard / edge AI perception](catalog/concepts/edge-ai.md): 78 items - Detection, segmentation, depth on embedded hardware supporting navigation.
- [Tracking and data association](catalog/concepts/target-tracking.md): 32 items - Multi-target tracking, MHT/JPDA, track fusion (for nav-relevant awareness, not weapon guidance).
- [Counter-UAS and drone detection](catalog/concepts/counter-uas.md): 78 items - Detecting, tracking and identifying drones (Remote ID, RF, radar, vision) - defensive.
- [Electronic warfare resilience](catalog/concepts/ew-resilience.md): 94 items - Operating comms and navigation under EW: spectrum monitoring, LPI/LPD links, fallback modes.
- [Standards and interface specs](catalog/concepts/standards.md): 112 items - ICDs, STANAGs, RTCM, NMEA, MAVLink, CoT, ASTERIX, interoperability specs.
- [Policy, export control and ethics](catalog/concepts/policy-ethics.md): 41 items - ITAR/EAR, dual-use rules, PNT policy, responsible military AI.
- [LLM agents for robotics and navigation](catalog/concepts/llm-agents-robotics.md): 47 items - Language models driving robots, mission planning, MCP servers for drones/ROS/GIS.
